2026-10-10: fixes for the six failures of the independent S7 re-review (docs/verification/phrf-cmp-s7-independent-review-20261010.md). Commit 7ff6636d on work/phrf-s7-reconcile, not pushed.

Each review regression was run first against the previous head 27339af6 with only the new types added, and failed there.
1. Missing contributions verified Valid. Now Unverifiable(MissingContribution), checked before any assembler runs. Test: OwnerVerificationSuite "review 1"; before the fix it returned Valid.
2. A commit exception lost metered CPU. checkpointOnCrash now persists cost.json before the crash propagates, and again after the workers join on a failure or interrupt. Test: PilotRunnerSuite "review 2", FakeClock +10 s, Done(7), throw at DataSealed: durable cost is 17 s (0 before).
3. A feed exception after GLMsingle ran dropped its CPU. The adapter now returns Failed(glmsingle_adapter_*, guard). Test: PilotArmsSuite "review 3", 37 s per attempt with 0 and 2 retries (before: the exception escaped and CPU was 0).
4. CpuGuard now refuses a hard ceiling above 60 core-hours. The only way past it is CpuGuard.raised with an OwnerCeilingRaise (ceiling, approver, reason), and the runner logs PILOT_CEILING_RAISE. Design 5.2 and runbook section 6 are aligned, and the tiny-ceiling resume test uses the authorization. Test: SchedulePolicySuite "review 4" (JVM and JS).
5. New refusals DatasetsOutOfPlan and PayloadLedgerMismatch. Tests: "review 5a" and "review 5b"; mutating the consistency check off fails 5b.
6. UnitPayload.decode now checks counts and lengths before narrowing or allocating, and the verifier contains decode failures as MalformedRecord. Test: "review 6"; before the fix it threw NegativeArraySizeException.
Also added tests for contribution discard on abort and for an earliest failed scheduled commit against a later successful one; a minBy->maxBy mutation fails the latter. The H1 probe title was corrected.

Gates: phrfComparisonJVM/test 499 total (489 passed, 10 skipped Python interop, 0 failed); phrfComparisonJS/test 245 passed; scalafimCompileAll exit 0 with 0 warnings.
Synthetic only: no pilot admission follows. A second independent re-review of these fixes is still needed.
